text.zh: OpenAI数学结果仓库继续更新
text.en: OpenAI Math Results Repository Keeps Evolving

text.zh: OpenAI数学结果项目的一次仓库更新，显示这批研究成果仍处于持续核查阶段。OpenAI科学家Dan Roberts表示，仓库新增了6项Lean形式化、修改了19项内容，并撤回了3项结果；目前约42%的顶层结果已经完成形式化。
text.en: An update to OpenAI’s math results repository shows that this body of work is still undergoing active verification. OpenAI scientist Dan Roberts said the repository received six new Lean formalizations, 19 modifications, and three withdrawals; about 42% of the top-line results are now formalized.

text.zh: 来源上下文列出的三份撤回稿件涉及Weil类、Kuga–Satake对应以及多个K3曲面的有理Hodge猜想。撤回并不等同于这些方向已经被否定，更直接的含义是，相关陈述或证明目前不应继续作为仓库中的有效结果发布。
text.en: The source context identifies the three withdrawn manuscripts as work on Weil classes, Kuga–Satake correspondences, and the rational Hodge conjecture for products of K3 surfaces. A withdrawal does not by itself disprove those research directions; it more narrowly means that the statements or proofs should no longer be presented as valid repository results in their current form.
The Value and Limits of Lean Formalization

text.zh: Lean形式化可以把数学定义、假设和推导转写为可由证明助手检查的结构，使错误更容易被定位，也让后续修订留下清晰记录。它同时带来一种类似软件发布的维护流程：结果可以新增、修改，也可以在发现问题后撤回。
text.en: Lean formalization translates mathematical definitions, assumptions, and deductions into structures that a proof assistant can check, making some errors easier to locate and revisions easier to track. It also creates a maintenance process resembling software release management: results can be added, changed, or withdrawn when problems are found.

text.zh: 但约42%的覆盖率不是整体正确率，也不能说明剩余结果已经完成机器核验。当前最重要的开放问题，是撤回稿件将如何修订、哪些结果会重新形式化，以及仓库持续更新后能否提高对完整数学论证的可审计性。
text.en: However, roughly 42% coverage is not an overall correctness rate, nor does it show that the remaining results have been machine-checked. The key open questions are how the withdrawn manuscripts will be revised, which results may be formalized again, and whether continued repository updates will make the full mathematical arguments more auditable.
